tradeoffs: The small gains in Top 10% accuracy (+3.34%) and minimal Top 25% improvement (+0.68%) are far outweighed by catastrophic underdog degradation (-4.23% accuracy, massive ROI losses) and significant overall model degradation (AUC -2.24%, overall accuracy -3.36%)
next_steps: Revert the feature removal changes. lessons_learned: Low-importance features may have indirect value through feature interactions. Removing features with importance 1-2 can catastrophically harm underdog performance even if it helps Top 10% slightly. The model's feature interactions are complex and removing 'noise' features disrupted underdog prediction quality, particularly for high-odds underdogs.
